integrity: Symbolic proof of the asymptotic uses a rare-pattern Poisson limit with uniform tails; finite reproducible checks are supporting evidence and are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted binary alphabets only; o(1) convergence without a sharp rate. The ratio is a candidate-to-necklace count, not an instruction-count formula. Historical priority against all unindexed longest-run literature and independent audit are not established.
title: Log-periodic overhead in binary quasinecklace enumeration
